title: Refinement of finite raw-compatible stage sections
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ be a precoverage on $F(j)$, let $V$ be a cocone with vertex $C$, and let $Q$ be a precoverage on $C$. Assume every transition $F(a)$ and cocone functor $V_j$ is continuous for the generated topologies [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and that the object and arrow cocones of $V$ are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Fix $i\in J$ and a set-valued sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. For $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$ put $A_t=F(t.hom)_sG$ and $V_t=V_{t.right}$. Give sheaf maps $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b.right)^sA_{t'}$ for $b:t\to t'$, whose composites with the inverse-image unit of $G$ are the unit at $t'$, componentwise as objects of the arrow category of sets. Let $B:\mathrm{Under}(i)\to\mathrm{PSh}(C)$ and $\beta_t:A_t\to V_t^pB_t$ exhibit $B_t$ as the left Kan extension along $V_t^{op}$. Assume $\beta_t(X) B(b)(V_tX)=\theta_b(X)\beta_{t'}(F(b.right)X)$ as objects of the arrow category of sets. Write $H=\mathrm{colim}\,B$ and $\rho_t(X)(s)=\iota_t(V_tX)(\beta_t(X)(s))$. Assume covering pullbacks exist for every $P_j$, and transitions preserve covering presieves and pullbacks along their covering arrows. Fix $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$, $W\in F(t.right)$, a finite indexed family $f_p:Y_p\to W$ generating a $P_{t.right}$-cover, and sections $s_p\in A_t(Y_p)$. Assume their raw images $\rho_t(Y_p)(s_p)$ are indexed compatible for the presheaf $V_t^pH$: restrictions agree on every common test object of $F(t.right)$. There are $b:t\to t'$, equalities $e_U:V_{t'}(F(b.right)U)=V_tU$ for all $U\in F(t.right)$, and sections $s'_p\in A_{t'}(F(b.right)Y_p)$ indexed compatible along $F(b.right)f_p$, with $\rho_{t'}(F(b.right)Y_p)(s'_p)=H(e_{Y_p})(\rho_t(Y_p)(s_p))$. This refines a family of sections already represented at one stage; it neither lifts arbitrary raw sections nor glues a matching family.

source.place: Tag 0A35 (lemma-compute-pullback-to-limit), finite matching equalizer, stabilization of overlap equations

proof.text: Take each pairwise pullback of covering arrows at t. Naturality of the raw map beta followed by the coprojection identifies raw images of their restricted sections with the two restrictions in hs. Thus hs supplies one raw equality for each pair. Apply finite raw equality stabilization with K = I times I to get one b making all theta-transported overlap sections equal.

Set s′_p = theta_b(Y_p)(s_p). Naturality of theta turns the equalities at the old pullbacks into equalities of restrictions along their mapped projections. hpullback makes the mapped pullback cone a limit. For any common test object at the new stage use its unique lift into that cone and apply the presheaf restriction map to the overlap equality. This proves indexed compatibility, including repeated arrows.

Cocone naturality V.w supplies e_U. Extract the equation from hbeta-map using Arrow.mk_eq_mk_iff, transporting its codomain through e_U. Compose with the new coprojection, use its naturality along e_U, and use colimit.w for b. Evaluating at s_p gives exactly the required raw-image formula. Sections are explicitly transported by theta, never chosen as arbitrary witnesses. The same construction works for an empty index set.
